subject: E-Commerce
title: Free Trade Zones and Bonded Warehouses
description: A fast breakdown of Free Trade Zones and Bonded Warehouses for builders.

hook.text: Dubai's Jebel Ali Free Zone handles $100 billion in trade annually. Goods enter and leave without paying local taxes.

buildup.text: Free trade zones let companies import goods, store or process them, and re-export without paying duties.

discovery.text: Bonded warehouses work similarly. Amazon uses them in Europe to store inventory duty-free until it's shipped to a buyer.

twist.text: Free zones create artificial tax advantages that distort competition. Local businesses pay taxes; FTZ companies don't.

climax.text: Free trade zones are loopholes by design. They accelerate global commerce but create uneven playing fields.

punchline.text: $100B flows duty-free through Dubai. Free zones trade tax fairness for global.

quiz.question: What is the benefit of a bonded warehouse for e-commerce sellers?
options: Inventory is stored duty-free until it's shipped to the end buyer
